version.changelog:
- Added guidance for acquiring notesctl from a public checkout if not already available.
- Clarified the first-success flow to explicitly start with notesctl acquisition via references/install-and-attach.md.
- Documented the MCP post-attach capability surface and provided details on available commands/resources.
- Updated documentation for clearer separation between preflight/attach proof, host/repo proof, and public listing boundaries.
- Improved examples and prompts to more accurately reflect control-room and MCP workflows.

llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent, but its normal setup path tells an agent to run unverified code from GitHub and install a recurring local job, so it needs human review before use.

dimensions.detail: A local macOS Apple Notes backup/control-room tool reasonably needs local files and same-machine MCP or web access, but Apple Notes data can be sensitive and the artifact relies on an unaudited external tool for that access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact instructs cloning a public GitHub repository by tag, optionally by current default branch, then executing ./notesctl; the executable implementation is not included in the reviewed skill artifact or verified by checksum/signature.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill gives broad operational instructions, including a current-main checkout option and an install step, without clearly separating one-time verification from persistent installation or requiring explicit user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The first-success and minimum proof paths include ./notesctl install --minutes 30 --load, which appears to create recurring execution, but the artifact does not document the scheduler mechanism, generated files, permissions, or uninstall path.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is local Apple Notes Snapshot setup, proof, and MCP wiring, and the documented commands fit that purpose, but they include executing an external notesctl program and enabling recurring execution as part of the first-success flow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review the referenced apple-notes-snapshot repository yourself before running notesctl. Prefer a specific audited commit with checksum or signature verification, run one-time proof commands first, and only enable the recurring 30-minute install after you understand how to inspect and remove the scheduled job.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrases are related to the skill's subject, but some are generic enough to cause accidental invocation; this is a scope-quality concern, not evidence of malicious behavior.
[EA3] expected: The cited text is a boundary warning against overstating proof across hosts, so I do not treat it as evidence of excessive agency.
[T03] expected: Acquiring notesctl from the public project is purpose-aligned, but executing a mutable or current-branch external checkout without artifact-included code or integrity verification is a material review concern.
[T06] expected: Recurring backup execution may fit the product purpose, but placing install --minutes 30 --load in the normal proof path without opt-in framing or uninstall details is a material persistence concern.
